dev.description: `lumiose dev`: Vite in middleware mode, modules compiled on request, SSR through Vite's module runner

prod.description: `node server.ts`: the `lumiose build` output on @lumiose/adapter-node (compress: false)

dev.description: `react-router dev`: Vite dev server, modules compiled on request

prod.description: `node server.ts`: Express + @react-router/express on the `react-router build` output, no compression middleware

dev.description: `next dev`: Turbopack dev server, routes compiled on first request

prod.description: `next start`: Next's production server on the `next build` output (compress: false)

dev.description: `vite dev`: Vite with SolidStart's plugin (Environment API), modules compiled on request

prod.description: `node .output/server/index.mjs`: Nitro's node-server output of `vite build` (no compression)

dev.description: `vite dev`: Vite with SvelteKit's plugin, modules compiled on request

prod.description: `node build`: the @sveltejs/adapter-node output of `vite build` (precompress: false, no compression)

dev.description: `nuxt dev`: Vite (Nuxt's Vite builder) with Nitro's dev server, modules compiled on request

prod.description: `node .output/server/index.mjs`: Nitro's node-server output of `nuxt build` (no compression)

dev.description: `node hmr.ts`: remix/node-hmr restarts the TypeScript server on changes and pushes browser updates; the asset server compiles browser modules on request

prod.description: `node --import remix/node-tsx server.ts`: the same sources in production mode (no build step; browser modules compiled on first request, minified and fingerprinted; no compression)

dev.description: `astro dev`: Vite with Astro's plugins, modules compiled on request

prod.description: `node dist/server/entry.mjs`: the standalone @astrojs/node output of `astro build` (no compression)

notes: Load: Chromium, CPU throttled 4×, no network throttling; COMMENTS_DELAY_MS=0.
Payload: bytes of the first load until ready and network idle; gzip level 6, brotli quality 11 computed offline.
Server: rounds interleaved across apps (order rotated each round), each after a 3 s cool-down and an idle check (1-min load average ≤ 0.5/core, waiting up to 60 s).
remix: no production build (the server runs the sources and compiles browser modules on request), so no build time or output sizes.
